scenes.summary: Upon arriving at the Mining Camp, Rossi tells you about Wulfgard's disappearance, hoping you could help bring him back. Eager to find him as soon as possible, she hands you a tracker she made herself.

lines.text: Thank Talos you took out those Aggeloi, Rossi! Those rock buggers would have destroyed our machines if you hadn't been around...
Just part of my job, Grandpa Ruud. Be careful on your way back!
Ah ... Endmin! You're here!
I was thinking that once the Mining Camp settles down, and I've taken care of the problems for the UW crew ... I'll go looking for you. I didn't expect that...
Nope, and it's all the fault of my unreliable brother.
He started behaving strangely after receiving some package yesterday. I didn't see him the entire morning! He wouldn't even pick up my calls!
Ugh. Catello is a huge bag of problems. Worse, he's always doing things on his own and creating trouble for everyone. But what can I say? Can't just ditch him...
I can't leave the Mining Camp — there's still so much to take care of. And ... you're the most reliable person I can count on, Endmin.
Grazie, Endmin! Ah yes, this is for you!
Yeah! It's a gadget I made a while back!
It can track Catello's bone charm — y'know, our family talisman. I've got one myself.
Just follow the direction pointed out by the tracker and you'll find him!
Ah! Almost forgot! Murat of the UW said he saw someone who looks like Catello at the ⟦key|Power Plateau⟧. You might want to start the search there, Endmin.
Catello doesn't care about much else. The bone charm's the only thing he's always got with him.

options: Everyone seems to trust you a lot.
You're getting really busy.
You didn't expect that "emergency" to happen?
Leave it to me. I'll bring him back.
Is this a ... ⟦key|tracker⟧?

lines.text: I trust Catello in your capable hands, Endmin! And I'll keep the Mining Camp safe! Don't you worry!

scenes.summary: You find Wulfgard after a while of tracking. He tells you about the entire event —— There are traitors in the Pack. Wulfgard feels he cannot simply return with this discovery, and feels extremely compelled to reveal the entire conspiracy. To fulfill your promise with Rossi, you decide to be part of Wulfgard's investigation.

lines.text: Endmin? Why are you here...?
*Sigh*... Rossi... I knew it.
Apologies, Endmin. I cannot head back just yet.
Since Rossi already told you... There's a list of names, a map, and a note in that package.
The names — they are Pack members who failed their missions in the past few months. As for the map and the note...
You can take a look at it, Endmin.
(NOTE writes: "Catello, interested in knowing how they failed? The answers are here.")
All the failed missions are partnership contracts between the Pack and Endfield. And those who died ... were some of the best members of the Pack...
A few days back, I got word that a Pack member had died... Tommaso. He was one of the very few true friends I had.
That's right. I don't care if it's a trap. I had to come here and investigate. I'll hunt the traitors down and make them pay. For Tommaso.
Yes. However, this is housekeeping for the Pack...
There's no need to get yourself involved or face risks for our sake, Endmin.
...Fine. I respect your choice.
But this also means you've entrusted your safety to me, Endmin.
For this joint operation, I might need you to stick to my arrangements if you can. Okay?
If the meddlers were other Landbreaker clans, they wouldn't be foiling us every time.
Just not too long ago he sent me a message, saying that there are traitors in the Pack. They're trying to sabotage our partnership with Endfield.
As you can see, I ended up being ambushed by a Bonekrusher mob. Good news is, I got fresh leads from them.

options: Rossi got me this job to look for you.
Your sister is worried.
Looks like a trap.
Someone is out to get you.
Is this why you're investigating this on your own?
Are you going after the trail?
But you are an Endfielder.
I promised Rossi to take you back.
This has something to do with the package you received, right?

scenes.summary: After defeating the ambushing Bonekrushers, you and Wulfgard meet another member of the Pack — Giovanni. He seems pretty close to Wulfgard.

lines.text: Careful. Don't let your guard down.
By Talos! What the blight is that?!
Eat the dirt, brute!
Nononono! Don't shoot! "The Twin Moons shall be one!"
You...
Catello! It's me! Giovanni! My friend, did you forget about me? We were tight — best partners on so many missions...
...Your performance was indeed rather ... unforgettable.
Heheh! I knew it! Alright, friends. This isn't a safe place. Let's talk somewhere else...

scenes.summary: Giovanni, disguised as a Bonekrusher, tells you that he came here to find Tommaso, whom he suspects has joined the Bonekrushers — However, Wulfgard just recently received news of Tommaso's death. Giovanni's story seems untrustworthy, but you and Wulfgard tacitly choose not to call him out on his lies. Both of you agree to let Giovanni tag along.

lines.text: Hooo... Okay. This spot looks nice and private. Let's get back to our little chat.
Giovanni, why are you ... here?
I knew that would be your first question... *Sigh* But trust me, you won't expect what I've got to say.
...I do. What happened to him?
Okay ... don't take my word for it — I'm just passing along whispers... Sounds like Tommaso's gotten cozy with the Bonekrushers...
You sure?
Of course I'm NOT sure! That's why I came all the way here. Even got myself an entire set of the Bonekrusher outfit.
Speaking of which, Catello, my man, why are you here?
There are traitors in the Pack and Tommaso's our biggest suspect. I'm ... also looking for him.
What?! You really think so? N-no way... Tommaso wouldn't... Maybe it's just some — some mix-up. Yeah, yeah, it's gotta be.
Got it. You need to wrap up your little investigation before calling it, right? Classic you... Oh, who's this sharp one next to you...? Looks like some serious brainiac!
She's...
I'm Wulfgard's current partner.
Indeed. We usually call her the Endmin.
lines.textM: Indeed. We usually call him the Endmin.

lines.text: Err... Okay! Let's change topic. So, Catello and Endmin, what are your plans...?
Hmm. I also want to see what our traitor ... is doing there.
Jumping straight to "traitor," huh? Aren't we a bit quick to judge?
Got a problem with that?
Oh, of course not! By the way, according to my intel, the Bonekrushers hid their camp underground... The entrance is at the ⟦key|Valley Pass⟧.
Let's go there to take a peek. What do you say?
Sure. Lead the way.
Alright, alright. I'll lead the way... Guess I'll have to put up with this outfit for a little longer...
Endmin? That's a catchy name. Hold on, Catello... What's your codename again? Wulfgard? Awww, that's almost cute — like a puppy pretending to be a wolf.
I'm here for Tommaso. That smart brother of ours who almost got admitted to HAS. Remember him?
I'm all decked out for slipping into their camp. Plan is to find Tommaso ... and if I do, he's in for a talk. Y'know, maybe I'll knock some sense into him.
Ahem...
How about you join me on a trip to the Bonekrusher camp? The intel I've gathered tells me that Tommaso might be there!
Hoo. Haven't seen Catello in years, but he's still got that blighted temper... Someone should teach him manners.
Way more than a decade! Hah. When we first met, he was still a little rascal who couldn't even hold his dagger!
But the kid was different from people like me. Catello picked up every weapon like it was second nature... Man, I was downright jealous of his skills back then...
So I begged him to teach me the ropes. Even his sister Rossi got fed up with my pestering! But I kept at it and snagged a handful of his slick moves myself.
Well, Tommy... He's a weird one... Grew up in the Pack but he got really good with books and reading. Whenever he got roughed up, it was always Catello and me who stood up for him.
Yet he forgave every last one ... including those who botched his shot at the exam. Can you believe that? What a hopeless case...
*Sigh* Why would a person like Tommy ... end up with the Bonekrushers? Y'think they strong-armed him?
A bunch of lunatics with zero brains but plenty of muscle!
Even the Pack, where I'm from, can't dodge throwing down with these crazies...
Hmph. If they were dealing with the Pack from decades ago... Welp, let's change the topic. Not like we can afford to poke the beasts right now, huh?

options: How long have you known Wulfgard?
Can you tell me about Tommaso?
What do you think about the Bonekrushers?
No questions from me.

r: How long have you known Wulfgard?
Can you tell me about Tommaso?
What do you think about the Bonekrushers?

lines.text: That was well played, Endmin... Our teamwork was pretty good.
It's still too soon to tell.
Everyone in the Pack knows Tommaso's dead, but Giovanni claims to know nothing... He's either pretending or just hasn't been back for a while.
No matter what, his ties to the real traitor should be strong. Talking about traitors ... we might have more than one of them.
Yes, and Giovanni is our perfect lead into the place. He's not very good at disguising himself, not even back then.
So, Endmin, please help me carry this show to its conclusion. Will you?
...Grazie.
Tommaso...? We've known each other for years.
When compared to Giovanni and myself, Tommaso was really the odd one in the Pack. He was too optimistic ... and too kind... But things often ended up in ways he didn't like.
Giovanni and I did take care of some business for him, but we actually owe him way bigger favors.
I hope not.
But ... many years have already passed. Time changes everyone it touches.
We can go now. Endmin, are you ready?

options: You think he's the traitor?
You want to bag them all at once?
Since you're so honest about it...
Piece of cake.
Can you tell me about Tommaso?
When can we get going?
Can Giovanni be the one ... who killed him?
Let's go.
I need to make a few preparations.

r: You want to bag them all at once?
Since you're so honest about it...
Can you tell me about Tommaso?
Can Giovanni be the one ... who killed him?
I need to make a few preparations.

lines.text: Didn't think the hidden underground camp was here...
You've been here before? So, still need me to guide you around?
We do. This place has changed quite a bit since we last came.
Yeah. They even reignited the denstack... I can hardly ignore that biting stench.
The situation might be worse than we think. Endmin, we should hurry up.

options: The Bonekrushers are rebuilding their turf...

r: The Bonekrushers are rebuilding their turf...

lines.text: Endmin, I think I see a few UWST crew mates over there. Should we ask them about the situation?
The UW? Woosters?! I ... I better not let 'em see me. Look at my stupid outfit... The woosters will beat me on sight!
I should probably check the other side. Maybe I'll corner a Bonekrusher straggler and pry a few secrets loose.
Catello, Endmin! I'll see you later!
Let's go, Endmin.

options: They might have some clues.

lines.text: The picture's coming together. The missing UWST crew mates were likely captured by the Bonekrushers. Their motive's a mystery, but if the raiders are really behind this, tracking them down should be easy.
Now that we have more clues about their camp's location, I'm guessing it's tied to the rekindled denstack.
Traitor or not ... the last thing he wants is us wasting time up here.
We just need to see through his plans and improvise accordingly.
And I agree. You're almost as quick as our sharpest Pack members, Endmin... Impeccable — for now.
...Alright, "partner", time to go. Let's find our missing UWST scientist first.
According to what the crew told us, we should find some clues at the site. Try ⟦key|scanning⟧ the place.

options: Will Giovanni give us a proper "clue"?
I'm good at that.
I am your partner, after all.

r: Will Giovanni give us a proper "clue"?
I am your partner, after all.

lines.text: This is definitely planned! They must have a camp nearby!
That's right! It explains everything!
Ahem, apologies... My fellow crew mate can get carried away at times. The UWST post at the Valley Pass has had several disruptions lately. We're trying to find out why...
Of course! I can't see anyone else doing this! These vandals won't stop harassing us! Once I find that camp of theirs, I'll make those pipefaces pay!
Location is key. We still haven't been able to find the exact place of their camp... Perhaps we need another approach.
The missing supplies, the sabotaged machines, and that weird tower suddenly belching out foul smoke... I bet the Landbreakers did everything! They're rebuilding their camp!

options: What's happening here?
Are the Landbreakers behind it all?

r: Are the Landbreakers behind it all?

lines.text: *Sigh* Thanks for saving me. I'm Yuley ... a UWST scientist... I ran into a Landbreaker during my patrols. He seemed to be trading with someone dressed like a refugee...
And then ... well ... they knocked me out. When I came around, I found myself trapped in this place...
Someone dressed like a refugee?
Yeah... That guy kept fiddling with a ⟦key|dagger⟧... The way it flashed really stuck with me.
I think I heard them mention something about the underground, some camp, and ... an ambush...? Oh! They also kept saying the "Pack". I don't really know what that means...
Just as I figured.
Endmin, this show of ours ... might be reaching its finale at the Bonekrushers' underground camp.
We have found enough clues...
Endmin, the next act's about to start. Let's go find Giovanni.

options: Do you remember what they talked about?

r: Do you remember what they talked about?

lines.text: Oh! I'm so glad you're back in one piece! I finally got some good news for Old Robert! He trained you well, and he'd be devastated if anything happened to you...
Sorry for making you worry... I was careless. If those two Endfielders hadn't found me in time, things could've been...
Stop beating yourself up! The Landbreakers are to blame for all of this!

scenes.summary: Giovanni manages to get the location of the camp from a Bonekrusher. He proposes a high-risk team combat operation. Wulfgard, known for being cautious, surprisingly agrees with Giovanni's plan. You know he is trying to test Giovanni. You decide to play along with Wulfgard's show and ensure the success of Giovanni's "plans".

lines.text: Eyyyy, perfect timing! I just coaxed the key clue from that squirming whelp. Wasn't easy, y'know!
Really? Tell us about it.
Heheh. The clueless runt spilled the camp's location. It's right behind that wall up ahead — there's a big hole we can slip through.
That location is already surrounded by Bonekrushers. Getting there might be troublesome.
Okay, hear me out... We charge as one — fast and relentless. No delays, just hit 'em and push through.
Yeah! Ditch the plans! Go straight up to their pipefaces and smash 'em in! How does that sound?
Sounds like a good idea.
In any case, fighting as a team will solve our current predicament.
...We might need to act faster than our adversaries.
Act faster... Ah, yes! Of course! Speed's our best ally.
Okay, then! That's our next move! Let's go!
Wha...? Of course, Catello...! You've turned into quite a decent team player!

options: You're talking about ... team combat?
What do you think, Wulfgard?

scenes.summary: After defeating the Bonekrushers guarding this place, Wulfgard notices something familiar about Giovanni's dagger. Giovanni tells him that he learned from Wulfgard's tricks and custom-crafted this dagger for himself.

lines.text: Hooo ... hoo... It's finally over. Mark my words. This was way more exciting than that fight we had with thirty Cartel bodyguards!
The Cartel guards wanted to stay alive. The Bonekrushers are different.
That ⟦key|dagger⟧ you're carrying. Is it...?
Oho. Catello, sharp and steady as always!
...I followed the tricks you've taught me, and got someone to custom-forge this blade! Hah! The handling and balance are awesome!
Really? I'm glad you like it.
It looks like ... a fine piece.
This is the entrance to the hidden camp. Shall we, Endmin?

options: Sure. Let's go.
Let me make some preparations.

lines.text: The Bonekrushers didn't build this place themselves. This seems like an abandoned underground factory of the UWST.
Hah! Typical Bonekrusher behavior. Well, they practically got a camp for free!
The Bonekrushers may have modified the local machines or facilities... Giovanni, lead the way.
Huh? M-me again?
O-okay... sure, I'll lead the way...
Yes. The show has yet to reach the final act.
Besides, from what I know about him, he's very close to his breaking point...

options: Should we keep playing along with the show?

r: Should we keep playing along with the show?

lines.text: Pfft. They call this an ambush? We've been through worse.
They were overconfident.
There should be other mechanisms, Endmin. Let's press on and look around. Perhaps we'll find a clue.
Bonekrusher glyphs... I remember that they like using these glyphs to pass on secret messages.
Most of them, yes...
You actually know this, Catello? I recognize none of this.
But knowing what the glyphs mean won't get this machine to work.
That sounds like a real hassle! I should leave you two to this job...
Yes. The correct sequence of the glyphs. I believe the ⟦key|clues⟧ should be somewhere nearby.

options: You can read them?
So I guess ... there are other tricks involved?

r: So I guess ... there are other tricks involved?

lines.text: Eh? Wait... Who's there?! Tommaso?! Is that you?
Giovanni! Come back!

scenes.summary: You and Wulfgard try to chase down Giovanni but fall into a trap. Wulfgard apologizes to you and admits that he has been distracted by his old friendship, and failed to treat Giovanni as a proper enemy and maintain his vigilance. Since you also fall into the trap, Wulfgard feels extremely guilty. In the end, he manages to steel his resolve and work with you to find a way to leave the place.

lines.text: You alright, Endmin? I slipped. Giovanni... I knew it...
...Good.
...You saw it?
...I guess you saw right through me.
Just like you said, Endmin.
I did ... hesitate.
Back then, I had only two friends in the Pack — Tommaso ... and Giovanni.
The encounters we had on this mission showed me one thing: he might look the same, but ... the Giovanni I knew is gone.
I should be the one bearing the consequences, but I got you involved ... Endmin.
...You're right. When it comes to Giovanni, I won't make the same mistakes again, no matter what.
Anyway, we should figure out a way to leave this place, partner.
These devices should be controlled by a mechanism nearby.
Good reminder. Let's find a ⟦key|device connected to a fuel pipe⟧, Endmin — that should be key.

options: You hesitated back then.
You never treated him as an actual enemy.
The Wulfgard I knew never left anything to chance.
But you're hoping for something, right...?
Stop making Rossi worry about you again.
Hey, I'm your partner. Don't forget that.
I think I smell fuel.

lines.text: ...That should do it.
You flatter me... Experienced hunters would always select their best hunting tools.
...Ahem. Since we're good, let's head for the deepest part of this place.

options: Guns fit you very well.

lines.text: ...Show yourself.
I know you're here.
Taking you down one at a time will drag on. Throw it all at me!
Big, strong words from a ... tiny runt of the Pack! The exit's closed — and so is your fate!

scenes.summary: After the battle, Giovanni suddenly appears and kills the defeated Bonekrusher chief. Wulfgard exposes Giovanni for what he truly is. After a heated argument, Giovanni claims there is someone else acting from behind the scenes. But knowing that he has failed their mission, Giovanni refuses to reveal more and suddenly attacks you, only to be killed by Wulfgard.

lines.text: Where is Giovanni?
Giovanni? What Giovanni? Don't know anybody with that name!
...Who put you on guard here?
Hmph. It's the traitor of that Pack of yours! Wouldn't show up himself, so your big wolf sends a little runt — *URK*
Hur. Useless... It was the perfect ambush, and you still failed.
Keep your guard up, Endmin.
Hmph. Catello, you were giving a pretty good show. What happened? You scared?
...The blade that killed Tommaso.
...Yeah? So what?! He believed in your blighted ideas and tried to sell me out! He deserved it!
You're the one who betrayed the clan.

Hah! I betrayed the clan? Please. The true Pack lives by purpose and honor... We don't sell out our own for some measly creds, trading blood and sweat to those companies! The real traitor here ... is YOU!
Some traditions must be set aside if we want more people to lead decent lives... We have to do this for our past, as well as our future.
Future? That path of yours leads to no future! The Alpharion is right! You're hopeless! Only the Alpharion could lead the New Pack to the glory we deserve...
The New Pack?
Hahaha! That's right! If I'm a traitor in your eyes, then you're gonna find a whole army of traitors out there! Did you really think that the New Pack is just a little club that came out of nowhere?
Have fun with your la-la land fantasies and stupid dreams, Wulfgard!
Who is your Alpharion?
Hah! Catello, do you really think I'll break my omertà?
I probably can't kill you, but it'd be nice ... to take someone down with me.
ENDMIN!
Who's the Alpharion?!
...Catello, this ... key answer...
It's ... yours ... to discover...
WRONG! We are what the Pack was supposed to be! And you ... you'll be our very first prey!
The incident is now over ... and the traitor got what he deserved. We should celebrate, no?
I'm alright, Endmin. No need to worry about me...
It was my choice. And I'm prepared for the consequences.
The same rule applies ... to Giovanni.
...Sure. I'll be right with you in a moment.

options: There's no need to hide the truth. This isn't you.
...Let's head out first.

r: There's no need to hide the truth. This isn't you.

lines.text: Endmin.
I may need to excuse myself for now.
Yes. He remains a Pack member. His final rites should follow the code of the Pack.
...I thought you knew already, Endmin.

options: You're ... laying Giovanni to rest?
How should I find you?

scenes.summary: You find Wulfgard who just laid Giovanni to rest at the outskirts of the Hub. Together, you burn the rest of Giovanni's belongings. Wulfgard tells you about their past. He also confides his subsequent plan, and hopes that you can keep the entirety of this encounter as a secret between the both of you.

lines.text: That was the first time we botched our job... We had to pay the fine. Tommaso sold the silver brooch his mother left him without a word.

Giovanni then spent three months looking for it... He paid double the price to buy it back from the underground market at Asphalt Roundabout — that was all his commission for the entire year. He told me not to tell Tommaso about it.
No. It was from me.
It was a gift ... for his twentieth birthday.
Rossi picked it. I was in charge of payment and delivery.
As for this one...
We should leave it here.
And now ... it's really over.
I did not expect to hear about this New Pack from Giovanni... I know nothing about the size of this operation, their goals, and most importantly ... their Alpharion.
Rossi often mentions it, and maybe she's right... The Pack of today is different from every Pack of the past. She, I, anyone really ... we'd all bear heavier prices to make changes.
But ... before that happens, I must verify something and make a few preparations with Rossi.
If possible, I hope you treat everything that happened here ... as a secret between us, Endmin.
I'll tell her myself.
Now's definitely not the time, as it shouldn't be.

options: But something else has just begun.
You don't want Rossi to know?
How about this pocket watch? Is that from Tommaso as well?

lines.text: Where did those pipefaces come from...? There is no end to them. Do we have to wait for reinforcements again?
We've already called for support! Problem is, another one of ours went missing yesterday. Things can't go on like this!
What's that badge you're wearing...? Endfield? You also received our call for support?
No. We were just passing by. I heard you got a missing crew mate?
Oh, yeah! It's Yuley! A scientist! He's about as tall as I am and wears glasses. He went missing when we were changing our patrol shifts yesterday.
*Sigh* That makes three gone, just recently...
And all happened in this very area?
Yeah. Right before or after we changed our patrol shifts.
Sounds like Bonekrushers' work... They often attack at times like this.

options: Need some help?

lines.text: An engineer's hat with the UWST logo. The label underneath has a handwritten name: Yuley.
A note with legible scribbles that read: "Patrols are boring... I hope I'm back at the Research Center and get back to my science project..."
Looks like the gate's locked. Can't open it right now.
